provenance.note: Peak ~23Nm@8500rpm, 20.6kW@8500rpm. Single-ratio direct drive via chain; revs to 12000rpm. Mass fixed 150kg, torque shape kept. With correct 11-corner geometry (Rmin 8.4 center, 25.3 racing, vs fake R44), fs125×south now 47.6s racing (-2.7% vs 48.932) within ±10%, rental>fs125 ordering holds on both south and sugo, Sugo West R15 anchor unchanged. Previous detuning (mu1.30/pf0.90/cda0.48) was to compensate fake R44 (-23.5% too fast); with true geometry, retuning back toward physical is required and now within bounds.
